description: This file defines an object `BonjourEscapes` containing a function `decode` that processes a string to decode escape sequences into their corresponding characters, primarily handling custom byte representations indicated by backslash followed by three digits.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a string input by interpreting '\' followed by three digits as a byte value, converting it to the corresponding character, and processing other characters as per UTF-8 encoding.
